subject: Request: Sub-95ms transient SLA carveout for PhotonPay integration
messages:
From: Jordan Lowe <jordan@photonpay.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Kulkarni <pkulkarni@photonpay.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration timing and a potential latency ask

Hi Rafael — great conversation last week. We’re wrapping up internal readiness for the Redwood integration and one ask came up from our payments ops team: during peak processing windows (two 10-min windows / day) they need a firm 95ms P95 on authorization calls for a 60‑day pilot.

Is Redwood able to provide a short-term carved latency commitment for this pilot that sits below our normal standard? We understand this is an exception. If it helps, Priya included a one-page outline of the traffic and SLAs — attaching here.

High level: pilot volume ~ 12k reqs/min at peak, average seq len small (auth tokens). Customer is willing to put a transit addendum in DocuSign and commit to an operational runbook.

Appreciate a quick yes/no so we can plan the cutover timeline.

—Jordan

Attachments: photonpay_requirements.pdf (pdf, 1 page)

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Jordan Lowe <jordan@photonpay.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration timing and a potential latency ask

Jordan — thanks, got the requirements. Looping in Aditya and Irene for feasibility and Marissa for product/contract ops. Quick ask to the team: can we support a transient P95 <= 95ms during those two daily windows for a 60-day pilot if PhotonPay signs the addendum and accepts our fallbacks?

Priority: high — this pilot is driving a broader payment integration partnership with their gateway.

Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration timing and a potential latency ask

Quick technical readout:
- Baseline: current hosted model mix at region-us-west processes similar auth calls p95 around 120-140ms under steady load.
- Path to 95ms: possible via temporary routing to a reserved Dedicated pool (hot launch configuration), aggressive batching knobs disabled for low-latency path, and KV cache priming for fixed prefixes.
- Operational tradeoffs: cost uplift ~2.2x for the pilot windows, and we’ll lose some throughput headroom in that Dedicated pool.
- Risk: if traffic spikes beyond 1.2x forecast, tail latency will degrade and fallback must trigger to standard model with graceful degradation.

If Sales + Legal are comfortable with the addendum and a fallback policy, Eng can prepare a config and smoke test in 10 business days.

-Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration timing and a potential latency ask

Thanks Aditya — adding product constraints:
- We can support a 60-day transient SLA carveout but need explicit operational guardrails:
  * Canary rollout for first 48 hours with increased telemetry retention for that account.
  * A strict auto-fallback (route to standard pool + tokenized degraded response) when p95 breaches 140ms for more than 3 minutes.
  * Weekly quality checks tied to our Optimize metrics so we can spot regressions.
- Contract ask: add a clause stating Redwood can exercise fallback if platform health is impacted. Legal will draft the addendum language — Marissa, can you coordinate?

Irene

--
Irene Choi
Director, Product (Runtime & Availability)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration timing and a potential latency ask

Thanks — legal and contracts flagged two items they want captured before we sign:
1) Explicit SLA scope (two daily windows; exact start/end times must be defined).
2) Financial exposure cap for the 60‑day carveout (we propose a credit cap tied to the pilot seat).

I’ll prepare a one-page addendum draft and the DocuSign envelope. Rafael, can you confirm the daily windows in PST that PhotonPay expects? Jordan / Priya — if you can confirm the windows we’ll slot them into the addendum and share DocuSign by EOD Thursday.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Sales Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Jordan Lowe <jordan@photonpay.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Kulkarni <pkulkarni@photonpay.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration timing and a potential latency ask

Thanks Marissa — confirmed windows: 09:50–10:00 PST and 16:10–16:20 PST daily. The ops team will accept the fallback clause as long as we get 48h notice when fallback is exercised and a post-incident timeline. We’ll sign the addendum once DocuSign arrives.

I’m attaching a short traffic sample (pp-4821-mtap-metrics.xlsx) so Aditya can size headroom.

—Jordan

Attachments: pp-4821-mtap-metrics.xlsx

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Jordan Lowe <jordan@photonpay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 15:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration timing and a potential latency ask

All — thank you. Next steps we’ll take immediately:
1) Marissa will send the addendum in DocuSign (expected within 24 hours).
2) Eng (Aditya) will provision a Dedicated hot-pool in us-west and run a smoke test against the traffic sample; ETA 7 business days.
3) Product (Irene) will publish the operational guardrails doc and the automatic fallback criteria; she’ll also enable extended telemetry for the account.

Sean — can you own the commercial note re: pilot pricing uplift (2.2x for pilot windows) and confirm terms we present to PhotonPay in the DocuSign? We should also propose a modest pilot credit to remove friction.

Jordan — once the addendum is signed we’ll target the 60-day pilot to start after a successful 48-hour canary. Rafael will coordinate the go/no-go check on launch day.

Rafael

--
